preconditions.description: The input number must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(digit in '0123456789-' for digit in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only digits and dashes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(str(num)[i] + ('-' if i > 0 and int(str(num)[i]) % 2 != 0 and int(str(num)[i-1]) % 2 != 0 else '') for i in range(len(str(num))))
postconditions.description: Dashes are inserted between each two consecutive odd digits in the input number.
